comparison.interpretation: Descriptive SELF-vs-ENEMY endpoint distribution only; a difference may motivate observation-policy hypotheses but does not establish pipeline-loss cause.

complete_retained_observation_universe.description: Accepted 13,059 edge-before observations plus each cohort's final after observation; no duplicate scope/tick snapshots are added. This supplemental census prevents dropping the six terminal observations.

historical_accepted_ui_capture.accepted_scope: One independently recorded own empty-neutral arrival and ownership transition, tick 65185 to 65186. No longer-trajectory claim.
historical_accepted_ui_capture.case: accepted own UI drag -> one SELF force -> neutral empty tower arrival/capture

L0_preextractor_input.basis: Durable BEFORE_INTENT and selection/hit-test records preserve UI intent and typed deployable, but the BEFORE_INTENT is prior to dispatch and explicitly records input_sent=false; no raw pre-extractor input payload is retained.

L1_extractor_output.basis: No separately retained extractor-stage object is paired with the canonical observation, so the L1 boundary is not independently evidenced.

L2_canonical_gamestate.basis: The retained AFTER_DISTINCT_TICK observation at tick 65185 contains the canonical GameState fields, including observed SELF owner/source/destination/units/progress.

L3_serialization.basis: Canonical state is retained as JSON in the recording; a paired explicit deserialize/reserialize boundary artifact is not recorded.

L4_simulation_state.basis: Canonical before-state at 65185; inject terminal=True using the certificate that the recorded before-intent direct path is exactly the current two-node path; inject fuel=150 from pinned newborn first-leg constructor. No other force fields were injected.

L5_readiness.basis: Static reapplication of the pinned endpoint/control field gate to the saved tick-65185 canonical state finds both endpoints and no control_readiness_gaps. The accepted capture receipt does not store an independent global-readiness record for this tick; simulation mapping remains conditional on terminal/fuel premises.

method.causality: descriptive only; endpoint distributions do not identify why observation differs or prove pipeline loss/visibility policy
method.current_leg_known: both endpoint Facts plus owner, relation, progress, unit_count, and a valid ten-type units vector whose sum equals unit_count are known; not a claim that motion/arrival is semantically simulated
method.endpoint_known: both source and destination are integer OBSERVED/DERIVED Facts; partial knownness is separately reported
method.input_ready: local endpoint readiness only: both endpoints resolve to positively visible towers and this exact force index has no source/destination readiness gap in the edge's before-state gate; not whole-state simulator readiness
method.owner: recorded relation when valid, with contradictions classified UNKNOWN_OWNER, using the frozen owner_class rule; otherwise only direct SELF/neutral facts qualify
method.unit: one force-record incidence in each accepted distinct-observation edge's BEFORE snapshot; the same snapshot may contribute again when it is the before endpoint of another edge
